ocl.postcondition: (bankCard.oclIsUndefined() = true and let newcard:BankCard in newcard.oclIsNew() and newcard.CardID = cardid and newcard.CardStatus = cardstatus and newcard.Catalog = catalog and newcard.Password = password and newcard.Balance = balance and BankCard.allInstance()->includes(newcard) and result = true) or (bankCard.oclIsUndefined() = false and result = false)
